text:
deploy-bot: :information_source: SDK v2.9.0 was promoted to hosted npm and internal CDN at 06:12Z. We've started receiving reports of client-side streaming resets for customers on runtime <= v3.1.x. Investigating. Rollback window 45m.
jess t: saw repeated 'stream reset' in client logs referencing frame_id mismatch. Affects multipart streaming for responses > 8k tokens.
liam: Are those enterprise tenants using SDK+websocket or the new http2 streaming? Any common config? 
priya: Quick triage: most reports are from customers pinned to runtime v3.1.0 and SDK v2.9.0 expecting new optimistic-chunk framing. Runtime v3.1.x doesn't understand the 'frame_signature' header introduced in v3.2 runtime protocol.
emily: This is unfortunate. Two options: 1) roll back SDK v2.9.0 from CDN, 2) apply client-side pin for enterprise accounts to keep them on SDK v2.8.2 (last known compatible). Which is less risky?
paul: Rollback SDK on CDN is low-ops but will affect everyone. Client pin limits scope. I'd prefer pin for enterprise tenants first.
liam: Agree + we should notify support + account execs. Priya, can you draft a short notify? 
priya: Drafting now. Suggest line: "We observed client streaming incompatibility between SDK v2.9.0 and older runtimes (<=v3.1.0). We've applied a temporary SDK pin for affected tenants while we coordinate a fix. No action required from your side." 
jess t: deploy-bot, can you apply pin for SDK clients for accounts flagged: acct-5201, acct-6023, acct-7700 in region global until 2024-10-06T12:00Z. Reason: client-streaming mismatch with runtime <=3.1.0.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Running: `deploybot pin --target sdk --version 2.8.2 --accounts "acct-5201,acct-6023,acct-7700" --region global --until 2024-10-06T12:00Z --reason "client streaming mismatch runtime<=3.1.0"`
deploy-bot: Pin applied. pin-id=pin-sdk-20241006-ents. Affected SDK CDN keys: 3. Rolling back global CDN staged edge caches in progress.
emily: Can we also add an entry in change log: "SDK 2.9.0: streaming framing change — requires runtime >= v3.2" and include mitigations.
paul: I'll open a PR for docs and deprecation notes. Link to PR: https://go/pull/3201
liam: Ops note: track metric client_stream_reset_rate by account; alert threshold 0.5% above baseline.
oncall-ops: nightshift alerting tagged — I'll keep watch and escalate if >1% for any account.
jess t: Plan forward: 1) keep pin for 24h while we push a runtime compatibility shim in v3.3.1 or revert SDK if needed. 2) prepare unpin playbook and canary (1% traffic) for 2.9.0 after runtime rollout. 3) customer communications done.
priya: Customer blurb done and shared with support. Closing thread unless regressions pop up. :white_check_mark:
